focus.$description:
Focus-ring stroke width, locked for every brand, theme and viewport — it sits on the raw step that meets WCAG 2.4.13's minimum focus-indicator thickness, so it is not a brand choice.

Used in:
The two bands of the focus.ring effect style — the inner band is one border-width.focus wide, the outer band a second one beyond it.

Do not:
Do not use it on regular component borders — those take the brand's border-width.sm/md/lg.
